Improve file search in the Repository screen and external patch input handling.

## Improved

- The Repository screen's `f` search now uses case-insensitive fuzzy matching,
  with exact and filename matches prioritized.
- Use the left and right arrow keys to move the search cursor and edit text
  in place. The prompt now reads `Find file (fuzzy):`.

## Fixed

- Reject pipes and other non-regular external patch inputs before reading them,
  preventing a wait on FIFO inputs. Regular files, absolute paths, and symlinks
  to regular files remain supported.

Source builds continue to use Zig 0.16.0. Linux x86_64 and macOS Apple Silicon
binaries are built and tested in ReleaseSafe mode.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/hiroaqii/gitframe/compare/v0.1.9...v0.1.10
